module: Flowgraph node "Custom Lua Command" (once_instant). Compiles with loadstring the Lua code received in the func pin then runs it with pcall. Outputs: flow (true if the call succeeded), return (any) value returned by the function. Useful for calling arbitrary code from a graph.
notes: If the text does not compile, loadstring returns nil and pcall(nil) fails: flow will be false, return will contain the error message.
Only the first return value is kept.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Disables clearing the output pins at start (clearOutPinsOnStart = false).

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the return pin to nil when the graph starts.

workOnce.desc: Compiles and runs the text of the func pin; writes flow = pcall success and return = returned value.

_onDeserialized.desc: Compatibility: converts the old data.func into the hard-coded string pin 'func'.
